## Why the wait is keyed the way it is

The completion watch keys on PROCESS EXIT (the single-flight probe going
CLEAR), never on verdict-file existence: the verdict is written only at the
gate's own exit, and an existence-keyed wait false-fired a premature "done"
twice in #1606. On exit the discriminator is the file — present => the gate
ran and its line-1 verdict governs; ABSENT => the run died before writing, and
that is fail-CLOSED (kill-before-relaunch, re-sync, re-run ONCE; never a
hand-written verdict, #1082).
